Find the opening hours of the National Museum in Delhi and the ticket price
2:10 AM

The National Museum in Delhi is open Tue to Fri, 10:00 AM to 6:00 PM, and Sat and Sun, 10:00 AM to 8:00 PM. It is closed on Mondays and national holidays. Today is Wed 28 Oct, so it is open until 6:00 PM. Entry is ₹20 for adults and ₹500 for foreign nationals. Students up to class 12 get in free with an ID card. Address: Janpath, New Delhi 110011. The museum's own page lists tickets at https://www.zoonga.com/national-museum. I only read the page and booked nothing. That page was last updated at an unknown date, so check the holiday calendar before you go.

Open the Indian Railways IRCTC website and check the train timings from New Delhi to Agra tomorrow morning
2:14 AM

The fastest trains on Thu 29 Oct are the Shatabdi from New Delhi and the two from Hazrat Nizamuddin, Vande Bharat and Gatimaan.

Shatabdi 12002: New Delhi 6:00 AM → Agra Cantt 7:50 AM (1 hr 50), runs daily, chair car and executive
Vande Bharat 22470: Hazrat Nizamuddin 6:00 AM → Agra Cantt 7:40 AM (1 hr 40), chair car and executive
Gatimaan 12050: Hazrat Nizamuddin 8:10 AM → Agra Cantt 9:50 AM (1 hr 40), chair car and executive
Taj Express 12280: New Delhi 6:55 AM → Agra Cantt 9:25 AM (2 hr 30), runs daily, cheaper chair car and 2S

For sleeper or AC berths, Punjab Mail 12138 leaves New Delhi at 5:10 AM and reaches Agra Cantt at 8:10 AM (3 hr). It runs daily.

The page was cut off after the 11:15 AM trains, so later ones are missing. It also doesn't show seats or fares, and I couldn't use IRCTC because it blocked me. Check the running days for Vande Bharat and Gatimaan before you plan around them.
